description: Watch, do not dispatch. Orbit desktop with its boards, agent sessions and activity view; no execution system attached.

components.role: coordination interface: collaboration boards, agent sessions, activity view
components.why: the observer profile is exactly this element; it coordinates nothing without an execution system but still shows boards and sessions

env_notes: no variable is required to run the unit suites; the browser-e2e CI leg declares chromium but no profile step installs a browser, so install one yourself before running that suite
ports: loopback only: the desktop app and its local services bind locally; the profile publishes no inbound ports
auth_posture: provider keys, when the user adds agents, live in user-only files with 0600 permissions, never in config files or git; an observer install adds no keys of its own
cannot_do: cannot create or verify attempts (no bundlebees attached)
cannot prove any work happened: a board status is never evidence that work completed
cannot start workers or hold a launcher queue
one-command first run for a stranger is not landed yet (docs/15); setup today still follows the maintainer deployment shape

refs.path: orbitdesktop: unit, browser-e2e, python-launcher CI legs
